fields.description: Erin is an apartment phase at Central Park, City Walk, with one- to four-bedroom homes. Some lower-level plans have broad outdoor areas, while other floors use smaller balconies. The contemporary buildings face the shared landscaped park rather than forming a separate gated destination.

overview: The selected one-bedroom plan has a much larger balcony than the reviewed two-bedroom plan. Their total areas therefore should not be read as a comparison of enclosed living space.
research.locationNote: At Central Park in City Walk, Dubai. The phase brochure confirms its park setting. Shared facilities and unit-specific outlooks should be distinguished from private apartment space.
research.priceNote: The original official price sheet starts at AED 1.59m for one bedroom, 2.61m for two, 4.85m for three and 9.16m for four. These are historical launch tiers. Property Finder now displays about AED 2.1m for selected availability; no current developer quote is confirmed.
research.paymentNote: The original developer sheet specifies 20% booking; five 10% instalments in June/December 2023, June/December 2024 and June 2025; then 30% April 2026 on handover. Passed dates do not establish a current resale balance or amended contract schedule.
research.handoverNote: Original official target: April 2026. Property Finder gives August 2026. The developer lists Erin sold out and still describes finishing and approvals. These references do not confirm actual delivery of a particular unit.
